verdict.rationale: Mastra docs confirm agents can be deployed as a server/API and self-hosted on Node.js-compatible runtimes (mastra-docs-18, mastra-docs-25, mastra-docs-11), and Studio provides local run/test endpoints (mastra-docs-50). However there's no first-party 'managed runtime' (Mastra Cloud/PaaS) evidence in this pack, no documented deployment API spec (openapi probe returned 404s), and no independent confirmation of a hosted call-as-API-endpoint experience — missing for 10: managed/hosted runtime offering, official deployment API reference, independent hands-on verification of calling a deployed agent as an endpoint.
